PluginData.Author: scotlandsyard
PluginData.Tooltip: Plans a tunnel to a deposit: angles, route, markers, and a rig line for your grid.
PluginData.Description:
Plans a tunnel to a deposit: from where you stand or any GPS to a spot a given depth under the surface somewhere else on the same planet, or straight to a point in space. It reads the planet and the terrain height from the game, gives the angles and the route, and marks the start, the turn and the target.
Quick start: 1. Type /digby in chat. 2. Pick From, Target and Depth, then press Calculate. 3. Markers are local by default (only you see them). Tick As server GPS for normal GPS entries. 4. Carry an empty datapad to use Write datapad. Digby can't make one.
Guide: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/tree/main/Projects/Digby Report bugs: https://github.com/scotlandsyard/SpaceEngineersPlugins/issues
